name: Hakari Yui
source:
After the trauma of being isolated in the past, she is resolved to use moving up to high school as an opportunity.

She dresses herself in the ideal "cute" and tries to become someone who is liked by everyone. 
As a result of her efforts, she is now the center of the girl's group in her class, and although people around her have come to rely on her more and more, she is also pushing herself too hard and is exhausted every day in the shadows. Because she stays up late communicating on social networking sites, she has bad grades and is hopelessly non-athletic. Recently, her friend group has been inviting her to goukon and to hang out with boys, so she wants a boyfriend urgently in order to reject those invitations.
